dct_description_sm: Education facilities from OpenStreetMap. Includes schools, kindergartens, colleges, and universities tagged via `amenity` or `building`. Useful for school-access mapping, education planning, and resource allocation. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [Key:building](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:building) - Part of: [HOT exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
